role: The fire aspect enchantment: metadata row only; the effect sets a melee target on fire for 4*level seconds.
scope_reason: Enchantments reach the world through loot books and villager trades even with the enchanting table off (world.conf enchanting = off).

members.name: EnchantmentFireAspect
members.note: row 20: weight 2, weapon, min 10+20*(l-1), max +50, level 2

notes: The class carries no effect code. The one ported effect site is the pigman's held-item attack: hostiles_pigman.c reads effect id 20 from the held stack's enchants and calls living_set_fire(target, level*4). The player melee path carries no enchantments on the recorded tapes, so that site is not exercised by an effect-level test; cited evidence covers the row only. The level is read by combatench.c:ench_fire_aspect for the player's and every mob's melee. lane/villagetrade 2026-09-27: the tail-only evidence (X-01/X-02) now points at the full re-records trade-full-s1, whose native replay starts before the behaviour.
